name: TR-Obsidian Intelligence Network Citations — Command Center
description: Dispatches the citation-traced research engine, generates vault notes, and owns the additive Command Center MCP bridge (32 tools), served only on the private Unix socket ~/.local/state/trinc/run/command-center.sock, never on a TCP port. Plugin ID is intentionally FROZEN — Copilot MCP tool ids, other plugins' api lookups and the bridge-token path all key on it; only the display name is suite-branded.
author: Trevor Robey
